metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Biosemi ActiveTwo system with 128 channels at 2048 Hz sampling rate, subsequently downsampled to 128 Hz. Resting-state recordings consisted of 4-minute alternating eyes-closed/open sequences. Preprocessing included visual inspection, rereferencing to average reference, bandpass filtering (1-40 Hz), artifact removal via bad channel rejection and ICA with ICLabel, and downsampling. Spectral features were extracted using Welch's method across four frequency bands (delta, theta, alpha, beta).
